correctness.rationale: PASS for the exact final claim over F2 with equation weights. Reconstructed Euler F=X F_X+Y F_Y+Z F_Z for degree5 in characteristic2; basepoint-free derivative triple iff degree-10 S6^3→S10 multiplication map has rank66, by the regular-sequence Hilbert series (1+t+t²+t³)^3 with socle degree9 and projective Nullstellensatz. Cartier/Hasse–Witt entries are coefficient c_(2I-J) of F in the 6-element canonical-differential adjoint basis; a=6−rank(H) and p-rank=rank(H^6), with six iterates sufficient in dimension6 and Frobenius twisting trivial for F2 coefficients. Inspected frozen C++ direct/orbit implementations and full source-blob identities; independent C++ enumerated ALL 2,097,151 nonzero masks, independently counted the same 688,128 geometrically smooth forms and all ten (p,a) frequencies. Separate group-action orbit verifier enumerated all 13,055 PGL3(F2) coefficient orbits, 4,204 smooth orbits and every per-stratum orbit population, with each orbit size dividing 168. Separate Python code independently verified two displayed curves with six unit Gröbner ideals, calculated H and H^6, counted points over F2^n for n=1..6, and reproduced shared Weil numerator but a=3 versus 1. The first six point counts determine the genus-six Weil numerator via Newton and functional equation; equal Weil polynomial gives F2 isogeny. Independently reconstructed frozen source tree and code/data subtrees from all 15 blob SHAs. Complete finite enumeration is exhaustive, not a probabilistic experiment. Reliance on recognized Cartier formula and finite implementation remains explicit.

It is not just the already published number of genus-six curves or their zeta functions. It can inform Cartier/Dieudonné and Ekedahl–Oort stratification of small-field moduli. The finite nature does not diminish the precise full-population unknown invariant; broader moduli or abstract-isomorphism distributions are not claimed.
